description.value: Lost Boys Café is a mountaintop restaurant perched at 5662ft (1726m) at Fernie Alpine Resort, accessible via the Timber Express Chairlift. It offers full meals, snacks, and Starbucks coffee alongside panoramic views of the Elk Valley. The café is fully licensed and operates as part of the resort's ski and bike park seasons.

address.value: 5339 Ski Hill Road, Fernie, BC V0B 1M6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Lost Boys Café is a real, operating café at Fernie Alpine Resort, located at the top of the Timber Express Chairlift at 5662ft/1726m elevation. The page states it is 'fully licensed' and serves 'a full meal, light snack or a cup of Starbucks coffee.' The site shows 'Currently Mon - Sun Closed,' consistent with the ski season ending April 12, 2026 and the summer bike park season not yet open as of late May 2026 — seasonal closure, not permanent. No amenity-specific evidence (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) is present in the website content.
concerns: Café is located at the top of the Timber Express Chairlift — access requires a lift ticket; not directly reachable by road-touring cyclists under their own power.

Website shows 'Currently Mon - Sun Closed' as of late May 2026; this appears to be an inter-season closure (ski season ended April 12, 2026), not permanent closure, but summer operating dates are not confirmed.
Phone number listed (1-800-258-7669) is the Fernie Alpine Resort central reservations line, not a direct line for the café.
OSM record has no address or phone; address and phone sourced from resort website footer.
